briefs.rationale: Extends the module brief past exact sequences, tensor products, chain conditions and Wedderburn-Artin to the principal ideal domain case: aligned bases, invariant factors, elementary divisors, Smith normal form and their uniqueness, and the specialisations giving the finitely generated abelian groups and the rational canonical, Cayley-Hamilton, Jordan and similarity results.

Keeps semidirect products, automorphism groups, Sylow theory and nilpotence, and adds the Frattini subgroup as the nongenerators with Burnside basis turning generation and the automorphism action into linear algebra over F_p, then the Galois material the part gained: Artin fixed-field degree, the subgroup-field correspondence with normality, and the action on roots with discriminants and resolvents.

Adds Beck monadicity to the reflective-subcategory and monad brief: canonical free-algebra coequalizer presentations, absoluteness of split coequalizers, the equivalence criterion with its strict and reflexive variants, and the applications from algebraic categories and the power-set functor to compact Hausdorff spaces via the ultrafilter monad.

Condenses the contour and Cauchy material and adds the local rigidity the part gained: isolated zeros and the identity theorem, the local power normal form, the open mapping theorem, maximum and minimum modulus, Hadamard three lines, and holomorphic inverses for injective maps.

Compresses the sigma-algebra and measure material into one paragraph and adds construction: outer measures complete on the Caratheodory measurable sets, covering costs extending a premeasure, sigma-finite uniqueness with the completion as domain, regularity, and the metric criterion for Borel measurability.

Carries the Legendre and Jacobi symbol development into the two-square problem the part gained: the first supplement, Thue small representatives, uniqueness up to signs and order, Brahmagupta-Fibonacci multiplicativity, the even-exponent obstruction at primes congruent to three modulo four, and the primitive and squarefree criteria.

Keeps the power-series construction of the exponential, logarithm and trigonometric functions and adds the several-variable pathologies the part gained: polar factorisation of Cartesian expressions, the failed vector-valued mean value equality, mixed partials, differentiability against unbounded or discontinuous partials, boundedness against equicontinuity, the sine solid of revolution, and non-injective spherical coordinates.

Keeps path length, the sharp fundamental theorems, line integrals and plane Jordan content, and adds the two gained developments: slicing between continuous graphs with the disc, washer, shell, cone and ball formulas in every dimension, and the Gamma and Beta integrals with factorial interpolation, Bohr-Mollerup, Gamma(1/2), Stirling and the unit-ball volume.

Keeps total derivatives, Jordan integration, convexity and the ODE development, and adds constant rank and surfaces: rank semicontinuity and the constant-rank normal form giving submersions, immersions, regular level sets, tangent kernels and Lagrange multipliers, then the first fundamental form and Gram determinant giving area, scalar integrals and flux.

Keeps covering-space classification, the circle and Seifert-van Kampen, and adds the applications the part gained: no retraction of the disk onto the circle with Brouwer and the fundamental theorem of algebra, Borsuk-Ulam on sphere-to-plane maps, commuting loops in a topological group, and punctured spaces separating the plane from other R^n.
